note: Small demo log. 4 obstacles. OBS-01 and OBS-02 were checked by eye on the Mars Trek map (CTX mosaic + HiRISE layers). OBS-03 is the steep climb itself, measured from real MOLA heights; it is scored by the climb rule, not counted as a danger crossed. Ground check: Curiosity Front Hazcam photos, sol 1000 (May 30, 2015), show broken rock slabs and scattered rocks in Gale Crater — the same kind of ground as OBS-02. Not a full survey. OBS-04 was learned by the Field D* replan demo: a fresh rock field it found and remembered, so the next walk avoids it from the start.
